MediaPipe / Google pretrained models (Apache-2.0), original model bytes:
magic_touch.tflite: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/interactive_segmenter/magic_touch/float32/1/magic_touch.tflite
pose_detector.tflite and pose_landmarks_detector.tflite: extracted from https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task
MagicTouch model card: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20MagicTouch.pdf
Pose model card: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20BlazePose%20GHUM%203D.pdf
Detector anchor and crop conventions: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/tree/master/mediapipe/tasks/cc/vision/pose_detector
